title: UN diplomats fail to agree on autonomous weapons regulations
excerpt: Representatives at a Geneva meeting left without forming rules for autonomous weapons, agreeing only to begin discussing options after fruitless talks.
body_html:
Diplomats meeting in Geneva gathered to work on regulations regarding autonomous weapons, commonly referred to as killer robots. Following a week of negotiations, representatives departed without reaching a concrete agreement on the matter.

Instead of establishing binding rules, the parties involved ultimately agreed only to begin discussing potential options moving forward. The talks concluded after a largely unproductive week for the delegations.
